observable_failure_step.description: Generated 03_parametric_assumptions.md and .docx with bold table captions and unjustified text.

root_cause_diagnosis: The generation logic wrapped Markdown table captions in asterisks (e.g., **جدول ۴- ۱۵...**), violating APA 7 guidelines which strictly prohibit bold table captions. Concurrently, the OpenXML generation for DOCX files omitted the necessary justification tags (<w:jc w:val='both'/>) within the paragraph properties (<w:pPr>), causing Persian narrative text to default to right-aligned rather than fully justified.
prescribed_behavior: The markdown generator must output plain text without asterisks for table captions. The DOCX compiler must explicitly inject `<w:jc w:val='both'/>` into the OpenXML paragraph properties for all Persian narrative blocks.
